title: The Garden Maze
description: Explore a formal hedge maze, discover the fountain courtyard and hidden garden, then climb to its raised terrace.

signs.text:
The formal garden gate
Enter between the clipped garden borders

The hedge maze
The path doubles back above the fountain wall · look beneath the ivy

The fountain courtyard
Bounce across the fountain’s separated basins

The hidden overgrown garden
The old garden has more than one way through

The raised garden terrace
Rise above the maze’s green walls
